description: Remove zone face apply conditions, which are described in the documentation for that command. If an optional range is supplied, the condition is removed only from those faces within the range. If no keyword is specified, then all conditions applied to the specified faces are removed. Warning (verified FLAC3D 9.7): the condition keyword is optional -- 'zone face apply-remove' with no keyword removes ALL apply conditions in the range, and a misspelled first keyword is treated as a trailing extra parameter, so the remove-everything action executes BEFORE the error is raised.
